hospitalName.title: Hospital name
hospitalName.description: e.g. "Kaiser Permanente San Francisco Medical Center". Used with Bright Data SERP to find the official site when no domain is given, and to pick matching locations.

domain.title: Hospital domain
domain.description: e.g. ucsfhealth.org. The Actor reads https://<domain>/cms-hpt.txt (CMS-required index of price files).

fileUrl.title: Price file URL
fileUrl.description: Direct machine-readable file URL (JSON or CSV, optionally zip/gzip). Skips discovery.

locationFilter.title: Location filter
locationFilter.description: Only process cms-hpt.txt locations whose name contains this text, e.g. "San Francisco".

codes.title: Procedure codes (CPT/HCPCS)
codes.description: Codes to keep. Empty = 23 common shoppable procedures (MRI, CT, colonoscopy, delivery, ER visits, labs...).

timeBudgetSec.title: Time budget (seconds)
timeBudgetSec.description: Stop reading after this long and mark results as partial.

byteBudgetMb.title: Byte budget (MB)
byteBudgetMb.description: Stop after downloading this many MB and mark results as partial.

maxFiles.title: Max price files
maxFiles.description: Maximum number of distinct price files to process from cms-hpt.txt.
